en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from hammad, from Al Halby, 
Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> has said:
‘There used to be a slave girl for Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> who used to slaughter for him<sup>asws</sup> whenever he<sup>asws</sup> so intended’.
en.sarwar: 7. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘ Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabiy who has said the following: “Abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
Ali ibn al-Husayn, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, had a slave-girl who would slaughter animals if he (the Imam) wanted.”’
